description: Defines error handling classes and error stream templates for EGL and ANGLE project, including egl::Error class, error codes, and related macros.

classes.name: Error
classes.description: Encapsulates EGL error code, message, and ID, with methods to retrieve error info and check error state.

classes.name: ErrorStreamBase
classes.description: Template class for creating error stream objects for different error types.

methods.name: Error::Error
methods.description: Constructors for egl::Error with various parameters.

methods.name: Error::isError
methods.description: Checks if the error object represents an error.

methods.name: Error::NoError
methods.description: Returns a static instance representing no error.
